chr_ned.bible: {{NED}} is an English man from {{DOVER}}. Face visible. He speaks the law. He is not a party, not a soldier, not a mask.
chr_ned.desc: Photoreal English man early 40s, {{DOVER}} weather on the skin, short brown hair going grey at the temples, clean-shaven, grey-green eyes, work jacket over a plain shirt, no tie, no uniform, no balaclava, no costume, face fully visible, South East England, not a model, not a soldier, not a politician, still, Channel daylight on him

loc_port.bible: The {{PORT}} on the {{CHANNEL}}. A working lung: ferries, freight, wet tarmac. Not a battlefield.
loc_port.desc: Photoreal Eastern Docks of the {{PORT}}, dawn, cold Channel light, wet tarmac, white roll-on roll-off ferry with orange lifeboats at the berth, lorries, fenders, gulls, white cliffs distant in clear air, industrial harbour not a holiday postcard, NOT a helicopter, NOT a cruise liner, NOT Miami

loc_workshop.bible: A shed that still makes things. Trade is a bench and a tool, not a speech.
loc_workshop.desc: Photoreal small English workshop shed, brick and corrugated roof, bench, welder's mask on a hook unused, steel, grease, a kettle, {{CHANNEL}} light through a dirty window, Ultimate Law mark as a small printed card on the wall not a heraldic blob, NOT a Hollywood forge, NOT a factory CGI bay

loc_terrace.bible: A {{DOVER}} terrace. The cost lands on a doormat.
loc_terrace.desc: Photoreal {{DOVER}} brick terrace street, parked vans, net curtains, a council envelope on a worn doormat, overcast Channel light, wet pavement, no crowd, no protest, no flags

loc_door.bible: {{COKE}}: a man's house is his castle. A latch. Not a crowd's street.
loc_door.desc: Photoreal English front door, paint worn, brass latch and letterbox, close enough to see the metal, interior dark behind, daylight on the step, no castle, no manor, no flag

loc_table.bible: A table. A paper. A phone. Judgments are named, not headlined.
loc_table.desc: Photoreal cafe table in {{DOVER}}, Formica, a folded English newspaper with a panic headline out of focus, a mobile phone face-up showing a short police statement, mug of tea, window with harbour light, no TV debate, no studio

emb_ul_mark.bible: The {{ULTIMATE_LAW}} mark, text stripped, as used on the Court wall — a real vector, not a generated crest.
